description_for_human: Browse golf cart inventory, check financing options, and find service-area details for statewide Alaska delivery.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to help users find golf carts for sale at Alaska Golf Carts. You can retrieve inventory (new and used), financing options (0% APR, multiple lenders), statewide Alaska service-area information, and brand/model information. The dealership sells electric and gas golf carts, street-legal LSVs, and lifted carts from 13 brands, serving communities across Alaska with statewide delivery. Inventory is updated daily. Phone: 1-888-840-4490.
